sources.title: Chronos — Foundation Models for Time Series
sources.snippet: Chronos is a family of pretrained models for time-series forecasting. Across the original T5 Chronos, the faster Bolt variants, and the Chronos-2 generation, the family has now crossed a billion cumulative downloads on Hugging Face.

sources.title: Chronos-Bolt (Small) — TSFM.ai
sources.snippet: Chronos-Bolt Small is Amazon's fast zero-shot forecasting checkpoint built for production use, at 48M parameters. It is positioned as a strong default in the Chronos-Bolt family: probabilistic forecasts with low latency and a simpler deployment footprint than the original Chronos line.

sources.title: Chronos-Bolt: Time Series Forecasting Model
sources.snippet: Chronos-Bolt is a transformer-based time series foundation model predicting day-ahead electricity prices with robust zero-shot performance across multiple markets.
